title: Applied ML clinic notes — quant/evals/onboarding cadence
content:
Context: quick capture from the weekly applied-ml clinic (informal lab-style sync). Goal is to record experiment leads, short results, and onboarding checklist items for new model variants we are trialing (mostly quantized open models and eval cohorts). Low polish — notes to self and action items included.

1) Meeting attendees + quick agenda
- Ravi, Elena, Jia, Maya, Tomas (remote), intern: Arman
- Agenda: (a) quant profiling summary, (b) eval cohorts for chat & summarization, (c) onboarding checklist for customer test models, (d) open infra blockers.

2) Quick summary (TL;DR)
- Int4 symmetric quant (our new qsym kernel) shows ~1.6x throughput vs q4f for 70B in our microbench (batch=1, seq=512) with ~0.8 delta in avg log-perplexity on summarization eval set. Latency tail stable after kernel patch.
- KV-cache misalignment observed when we apply fused aten kernel for rotary; reproduced locally with synthetic streams. Hypothesis: alignment/stride rounding in mixed-precision path.
- Eval cohorts: added a small regression suite focused on instruction-following consistency (25 prompts) + hallucination probes (12 items). Early flags for Llama2-70b qsym on code generation prompts.

3) Experiment log (short runs)
- run: qsym-70b-b512-b1-2026-09-14
  * hw: A10G, 64-token warmup, batch=1, seq=512
  * perf: 67 tokens/s (vs baseline 41 tokens/s for q4f)
  * quality: avg ppl +0.8, instr-acc drop 1.5% on small instruction cohort
  * note: enables fused-gemm-tiling v2

- run: int8-hybrid-35b-sweep-09015
  * hw: A100-sxm, batch=4, seq=256
  * perf: 180 tokens/s, memory 36GB (stable)
  * quality: negligible delta on embedding similarity; code-gen hallucinations unchanged

- kv-cache repro: kv-rotary-fuse-check-09016
  * observed: when tokenization boundary crosses cache segment boundary -> outputs diverge after 24 tokens
  * temp workaround: disable rotary-fuse on sequences > 1024 or fallback to per-layer apply
  * action: assign to infra (Tomas) to add an alignment unit test and a synthetic reproducer in CI by 2026-09-22

4) Onboarding checklist for new model variants (candidate: Llama2-70b-qsym)
- basic smoke: start container, load model, run gen sample -> PASS
- perf baseline: measure cold start, steady-state qps, p50/p95 tail
- cost estimate: tokens/s -> projected $/M tokens (see spreadsheet link in linked_artifacts)
- eval suite: run instruction-cohort + summarization + code-gen + hallucination probes -> collect metrics
- regression gating: if instr-acc drops >2% or hallucination F1 drops >5% -> block
- telemetry: enable token-level cost traces, kv-cache-hit metrics, and kernel-version tag
- rollout plan: canary 5% traffic -> 25% -> full, with automatic fallback on error rate or latency SLO breach

5) Evals: new cohort definitions and quick results
- Cohort A: short instructions (5–20 tokens) for safety and instruction following (25 prompts)
- Cohort B: long-context summarization (3 articles, ~2–3k tokens each)
- Cohort C: code generation (small functions, 12 prompts) — watch for hallucinations and compilation errors
- Quick numbers (prelim): qsym-70b: instr-acc 92.8% (baseline 94.1%), hallucination-F1 0.71 (baseline 0.75)

6) Open questions / discussion points
- Is the 1.6x throughput worth the small quality delta for self-serve hosted tier? Product wants a more conservative gating for hosted API customers. Need BU input.
- Can we tune per-layer clip/scale to reduce instruction-acc drop? Proposal: small per-layer scale sweep (5–10% range) next sprint. Owner: Jia.
- KV-cache bug root cause: alignment vs kernel tiling decisions. If kernel needs padding, we may pay memory/regression cost. Discuss with serving-runtime team.

7) Action items (owners + dates)
- Tomas: add KV-cache synthetic reproducer + unit test in runtime CI (due 2026-09-22).
- Jia: run per-layer scale sweep (params: scale=[0.9,0.95,1.0,1.05], layers=[all,odd,last4]) on qsym-70b and report metrics (due 2026-09-25).
- Elena: prepare an internal one-pager for product explaining tradeoffs and recommended gating for hosted vs dedicated (due 2026-09-21).
- Arman (intern): build a lightweight dashboard slice showing p50/p95 tokens/s and instr-acc over last 7 days for trial models (due 2026-09-24).

8) Notes to self / rough ideas
- Consider a "quality tax" knob that can be toggled per-customer to bias toward higher quality quant kernels (slower but safer) — discuss feasibility with routing team.
- Might be worth a tiny eval job that computes embedding drift after quantization for long-running retrieval systems.

9) References / links (quick)
- Confluence: quant strategy (linked above)
- GH PR: kernel tiling patch (#4821) — gives perf win but maybe alignment issue
- Jira: AM-1973 tracks onboarding checklist automation

10) Retro: what went well / what to improve
- Went well: faster iteration loop on perf metrics, good cross-team pairing on kernel profiling.
- Improve: capture reproducible seeds and script arguments in every perf run (we missed a seed on qsym-70b run).

---
End of notes. Will update after per-layer sweep results and unit-test PR lands.
